# IP Defense

> IP Defense is a managed brand protection and online enforcement service that removes copycat apps, impersonators, and lookalike listings across app stores, social platforms, marketplaces, and web domains. Technology finds the threats; expert analysts verify them and manage takedowns to resolution.

IP Defense is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. It combines continuous monitoring with a human-led enforcement team, following a three-step process: Discover (continuous brand intelligence), Verify (analyst review of every threat before action), and Resolve (complaints filed, escalations managed, cases tracked to close). Platforms make the final removal decision; IP Defense prepares verified evidence, files through the correct channels, and manages follow-up.

## Service tiers
- Intelligence Only: AI-powered monitoring with expert-reviewed intelligence reports, for teams that enforce in-house.
- Guided Protection: adds enforcement strategy, complaint and evidence guidance, and ongoing case support.
- Managed Protection (most popular): fully outsourced brand protection — end-to-end case management, takedown submissions, platform escalation, and dedicated account management.

Pricing is bespoke, scoped to each brand's footprint, platforms, and active infringement volume. Engagements begin with a paid Onboarding Review that produces an IP Defense Action Plan.
